text_en: Early in the morning Joshua rose and set out from Shittim with all the Israelites, and they came to the Jordan. They camped there before crossing over.
text_cn: 若苏厄清早起来，同所有的以色列子民由史廷出发，来到了约但河，住在那里，等候过河。

text_en: At the end of three days the officers went through the camp
text_cn: 过了三天，官长走遍全营，

text_en: and commanded the people, “When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God being carried by the levitical priests, then you shall set out from your place. Follow it,
text_cn: 吩咐百姓说：“你们一看见上主你们天主的约柜，和抬约柜的肋未人，你们便由你们所住的地方起身，跟着它走，

text_en: so that you may know the way you should go, for you have not passed this way before. Yet there shall be a space between you and it, a distance of about two thousand cubits; do not come any nearer to it. ”
text_cn: 好使你们知道你们应走的路，因为这条路你们从来没有走过。但在你们与约柜之间，应相隔二千肘，不可走近约柜。”

text_en: Then Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you. ”
text_cn: 若苏厄对百姓说：“你们应该自洁，因为上主明天要在你们中间行神迹。”

text_en: To the priests Joshua said, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass on in front of the people. ” So they took up the ark of the covenant and went in front of the people.
text_cn: 若苏厄又吩咐司祭说：“你们抬起约柜，在百姓前过河。”他们遂抬起约柜，走在百姓前面。

text_en: The Lord said to Joshua, “This day I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so that they may know that I will be with you as I was with Moses.
text_cn: 上主对若苏厄说：“今天我要开始在众以色列眼前显扬你，使他们知道我要与你同在，有如我过去与梅瑟同在一样。

text_en: You are the one who shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, ‘When you come to the edge of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan. ’”
text_cn: 你吩咐抬约柜的司祭说：“你们一到约但河的水边，就停在约但河边。”

text_en: Joshua then said to the Israelites, “Draw near and hear the words of the Lord your God. ”
text_cn: 若苏厄又吩咐以色列子民说：“你们前来静听上主你们天主的话。”

text_en: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that among you is the living God who without fail will drive out from before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites:
text_cn: 若苏厄遂说：“你们由此可知道，永生的天主是在你们中间， 他必从你们面前，将客纳罕人、赫特人、希威人、培黎齐人、基尔加士人、阿摩黎人和耶步斯人赶走。

text_en: the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is going to pass before you into the Jordan.
text_cn: 看大地主宰的约柜要在你们前面渡过约但河。

text_en: So now select twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.
text_cn: 现在，你们应从以色列支派中，挑选十二人，每支派一人。

text_en: When the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of the Lord , the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan flowing from above shall be cut off; they shall stand in a single heap. ”
text_cn: 当抬大地的主宰上主约柜的司祭的脚掌，一踏入约但河的水，约但河的水就必中断，由上流下的水要停住，像一道堤。”

text_en: When the people set out from their tents to cross over the Jordan, the priests bearing the ark of the covenant were in front of the people.
text_cn: 当百姓起程离开帐幕要过约但河时，司祭抬着约柜，走在百姓的前面。

text_en: Now the Jordan overflows all its banks throughout the time of harvest. So when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests bearing the ark were dipped in the edge of the water,
text_cn: 当抬约柜的司祭到了约但河，他们的脚一踏入水边，──原来约但河在整个收割期间，水常涨至河岸──

text_en: the waters flowing from above stood still, rising up in a single heap far off at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan, while those flowing toward the sea of the Arabah, the Dead Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
text_cn: 水就停住了：由上流下的水像一道堤，停在很远的地方，远至匝尔堂附近的阿当城；往下流入阿辣巴海，即盐海的水，已全退去；于是百姓在耶里哥对面过了河。

text_en: While all Israel were crossing over on dry ground, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, until the entire nation finished crossing over the Jordan.
text_cn: 当全以色列人在旱地上渡过时，抬上主约柜的司祭稳立在约但河中的旱地上，直到全民众都渡过约但河。
